status: proposed for original artwork; no Duolingo production rig included
character_choice: learner team to choose; existing Sumi is a placeholder

suggested_application_inputs.state: one of the state IDs; bind to a runtime enum/integer or explicit animation mapping
suggested_application_inputs.progress: real task/download progress from 0 to 1; never fabricated from time
suggested_application_inputs.reduced_motion: show poster pose and text instead of animated loops
suggested_application_inputs.optional_viseme_index: only if a future real speech stream drives it

behaviour_rules: State changes must not delay or disable the learner's controls.
Pause animation when the application backgrounds.
Always provide the same meaning through text and a still pose.
Download success is not model readiness; keep those events separate.
Model output does not by itself certify mastery or complete project work.
Cancel or error transitions must interrupt thinking/download status promptly.
